title: Lint hardening only half-landed: cross-arm demo guard still satisfies the 35-line window (reproduced), DEMO_INTERCEPTED cross-check and bite-tests absent
evidence: # Find the enclosing scope: walk back to the nearest message arm ... for j in range(idx - 1, -1, -1): ... break ... if arm_name in EXEMPT_ARMS or arm_name in DEMO_INTERCEPTED: continue ... # Check a generous window above the call for a demo_mode guard in the same scope ... window = "\n".join(lines[max(0, idx - 35) : idx]) / guarded = "model.demo_mode" in window or "updated_model.demo_mode" in window — the arm boundary j is never used to clip the window. Empirical repro (temp copy, worktree untouched): injected `payment_api.fire_pixel_purchase_for_session("x", msg.AppNoOp)` in a fresh non-exempt arm (UserClickedDemoCtaXXX) 26 lines below the model.demo_mode guard in UserToggledNotificationDropdown -> lint exit 0 (clean). Manifest sync is prose only: '# Keep this in sync with the request messages in demo_update.handle — a message listed here must have a demo arm there' (lines 41-43); grep finds no mechanical check and no bite-tests anywhere in the repo.
detail: The r3 guard claimed 'a cross-arm guard does NOT satisfy' plus manifest cross-check and three bite-tests. Only the demo/ api-import ban landed (test.yml). A future unguarded call near another arm's guard passes silently. Tree itself is clean today, so pillar 1 holds — the pin is weaker than claimed.
recommended_fix: Clip the guard window at the enclosing arm boundary (window = lines[j:idx]); add a mechanical DEMO_INTERCEPTED vs demo_update.handle arm cross-check; add the three synthetic-violation bite-tests to CI.
